svg.text: The OS disk is copied byte for byte, so everything inside it comes along; the VM resource around it is built new, and a few things are deliberately left out.

svg.text: The disk is attached with -CreateOption Attach, so no first-boot provisioning runs: same name,

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: same accounts, same SID. That is right for test copies, upgrade rehearsals and forensic copies,

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and wrong for two machines on one domain.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Clone first, then run sysprep.exe /generalize /oobe /shutdown in the clone (never the original:

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Sysprep is one-way) and capture to the gallery as Generalized. Every VM deployed from it gets new

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Snapshot of a running VM is crash-consistent; stop (deallocate) the source for a clean disk. Snapshots and disks bill until deleted. Controls: CP (clone and restore paths); CIS: RDP/SSH never exposed.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Generalised design: no client names, tenant IDs, addresses or data. Icons are simplified originals, not Microsoft artwork.

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
